ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid operator's rise to riches amid fraud allegations
ideas.description: Investigate the bankruptcy-to-riches rise of a Minnesota Medicaid operator amid allegations of fraud.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail and investigate potential connections to high-profile figures.
